results.check:
A1 [THE REGIME] the cluster interior is DEEP NEWTONIAN (g_N/a_0 > 3)
      and the boost g/g_N is therefore near 1 there
results.measured: g_N/a_0 = 2.18 at 75 kpc, 0.65 at 420 kpc; g/g_N = 1.2250 at 75 kpc

results.check:
B1 [THE PHANTOM SUPPLIES THE SHAPE] the phantom's logarithmic slope
      in the certified window is close to the observed -1.53

B2 [THE DUST SUPPLIES THE BULK] at 420 kpc the free dust carries the
      majority of the required dark mass
results.measured: at 420 kpc: M_phantom = 5.410e+13 Msun, M_dust = 4.593e+14 Msun, total = 5.134e+14; required 6.8x baryon = 5.232e+14

results.check:
C1 [ADMISSIBLE] the required dust density is within the cosmological
      cold-sector budget (not an absurd over-density)
results.measured: mean dust density inside 420 kpc = 1.002e-22 kg/m^3; cosmic Omega_dm rho_c = 2.261e-27; ratio = 44305.8

results.check:
C2 [COLD AND COLLISIONLESS] the dust has c_s^2 = 0 exactly (it is a
      conserved charge density, not a fluid with pressure)
results.measured: c_s^2(dust) = 0 by construction (Noether charge, no pressure)

results.check:
C3 [THE SHAPE IS THE FALSIFIABLE PART] the THEORY predicts the
      residual slope from the field solve (phantom) + a^-3 collapse
      (dust), while LCDM predicts NFW (slope -1 in the core, -3 outside)
results.measured: theory: phantom slope ~-1.37/-1.40 (G017) steepened by dust; observed -1.53; NFW: -1 -> -3

results.check:
D1 [WHAT IS NOT DERIVED] the free dust's NORMALISATION is not derived
      -- it is set by the cluster's collapse history, exactly as in LCDM.
      This is Requirement 10 (the amplitude law), still open.
results.measured: dust amplitude: set by collapse history, NOT derived from the action

results.check:
D2 [THE KILL CONDITION] if the measured cluster core slope is -1 (NFW)
      rather than ~-1.5, the two-component construction is dead
results.measured: kill: inner slope consistent with -1 and inconsistent with -1.5

resolution: phantom (outskirts, shape, zero-param) + free dust (interior, bulk, astrophysical normalisation)
